summary: Jet.AI Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the adjournment of its special meeting of stockholders to vote on the proposed merger with flyExclusive, Inc. As of June 23, 2026, 48.4% of outstanding shares were represented, with 99.0% of votes cast in favor, but insufficient for majority-of-outstanding approval. The meeting was adjourned to July 2, 2026 for further proxy solicitation. No terms (price, premium, etc.) are restated. The filing is a procedural update, not a definitive event. Watch for shareholder turnout and potential extension or deal risk if approval fails.
